t.zh: 一张照片在不同工具中显示时，蓝天可能变成橙色：原因可能是颜色通道的排列顺序不同。Workshop 2 中，OpenCV 读入的顺序为 B、G、R，而 Matplotlib 按 R、G、B 显示。图像计算还需要留意数据类型：uint8 的范围为 0 到 255，超出范围的运算结果可能发生回绕。
t.en: A photograph can display an orange sky in another tool because its colour channels are ordered differently. In Workshop 2, OpenCV reads B, G, R while Matplotlib displays R, G, B. Image calculations also depend on data type: uint8 ranges from 0 to 255, and arithmetic results outside that range can wrap around.

t.zh: 怎样恢复照片的颜色？<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>将三张<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>依次作为 R、G、B 通道合成彩色图。
t.en: How can the photograph’s colours be restored? <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> combines three <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref> as the R, G and B channels of a colour image.

after.zh: 不同工具的颜色通道顺序可能不同，交换顺序前需要确认输入和输出的约定（<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>）。整数类型的取值范围也会影响计算结果（<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>）；计算前应选择足以容纳结果的类型。
after.en: Tools may use different channel orders, so check input and output conventions before rearranging them (<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>). Integer ranges also affect computed results (<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>); choose a type that can hold the result before computing.

brief.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
brief.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

hint.zh: 先把输入原样接到输出，看第一个不同的格子里哪几个数对调了。
hint.en: First wire the input straight to the output, and see which numbers are swapped in the first differing cell.

hint.zh: 把三个位置的数分别取出来看：天空在哪一张里最亮？蓝天本该亮在哪一种颜色上？
hint.en: Take the numbers at the three positions out one by one: in which of them is the sky brightest? Which colour should a blue sky be bright in?
